**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `ydgC`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99% of them, at 0.02 bits.

**The rest of the window is fork and variable columns**, 1 to 79, carried by 12 to 86%, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 72% of calls. A branch of 68 families runs through columns 1 to 68, `rstA` to `fumD`, carried by 11 to 13%. Columns 6 to 9, `tqsA` to `mdtI`, are [[multidrug efflux transporters]].

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 99 against 86%, and hesitates less there, 0.02 against 0.64 bits. Its most hesitant column, 31, "site-specific integrase", is a fork column, at 1.46 bits.

**The window ends on fork columns.** Column 79, "phage minor tail protein L", is carried by 20% of chromosomes. Columns 74 to 76, "phage tail protein" to "phage tail assembly protein T", are [[phage tail assembly]].

**Across the window it names 86% of genes**, 0.63 bits on average, perplexity 1.9 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.25 against 0.23 bits, and names fewer genes, 78% against 92%.

label: ydgC
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the ydgC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ydgC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,132 to 2,211 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ydgC once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 86% of genes, 0.63 bits on average (perplexity 1.9 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 23,612 calls, named 96%, 0.21 bits; shell 18,536 calls, named 78%, 1.04 bits; cloud 812 calls, named 20%, 3.78 bits. Outside an RGP 25,780 calls, named 92%, 0.23 bits; inside an RGP 17,180 calls, named 78%, 1.25 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 77 fork, 2 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.25 against 0.23 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 92%); 17,180 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 31 ("site-specific integrase", a fork column) 1.46 bits, RGP 55%; column 36 (dcp, a fork column) 1.22 bits, RGP 56%; column 43 (marB, a fork column) 1.06 bits, RGP 64%. The 51 columns (columns 29-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 84%, 0.85 bits on average; the other 29 columns: named 91%, 0.26 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 99%, 0.02 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 86%, 0.64 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 31, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: ydgC "GlpM family protein". named 99%; 0.02 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 12-86%, 48 P, 31 S, RGP 0-72%. named 37-99% (mean 86%), fewest named at column 7, named 37%; most hesitant at column 31, 1.46 bits.
